title: How to Grant Access to Membership Courses Using Workflows
html:
This help article will show you how to grant access to your membership courses using workflows in KenjiAI. Whether you’re managing online learning programs, exclusive content, or training materials, workflows provide an automated way to enroll users seamlessly.

TABLE OF CONTENTS

  • What is Granting Membership Access Using Workflows?
  • Key Benefits of Granting Membership Course Access via Workflows
  • How To Grant Access to Membership Courses Using Workflows
  • Frequently Asked Questions
  • Related Article

What is Granting Membership Access Using Workflows?


Granting Membership Access using Workflows is a no-manual-touch way to enroll people into your KenjiAI membership courses. Instead of adding members one-by-one, you define triggers (e.g., form submission, payment completed, tag added) and an action, Course Grant offer, so access is given automatically and immediately.

Key Benefits of Granting Membership Course Access via Workflows


  • Automation at Scale: Eliminate the need for manual enrollment by automatically granting access upon user signup or payment.

  • Enhanced User Experience: Members gain immediate access to courses without delays, improving satisfaction and reducing inquiries.

  • Error Reduction: Automations minimize the risk of human errors, such as forgetting to enroll a user or assigning incorrect access levels.

  • Time-Saving: Focus on creating valuable content while workflows handle the administrative tasks.

  • Customizable Triggers: Tailor workflows to suit your business model, such as granting access after a specific form submission or purchase.

How To Grant Access to Membership Courses Using Workflows


Step 1: Navigate to Workflows


  1. Log in to your sub-account account.

  2. From the dashboard, go to Automation > Workflows.


Step 2: Create a New Workflow


  1. Click on the + Create Workflow button.

  2.  Create your workflow from scratch, using templates, or using AI.



Step 3: Set a Trigger


  1. Select the trigger that will initiate the workflow, such as:

    • Form submitted.

    • Payment completed.

  2. Select the form/s, payment source using filters.




Step 4: Add an Action


  1. Choose Course Grant Offer as the action.

  2. Select the course or membership product you want to grant access to.


Step 5: Test  & Publish Workflow


  1. Run a test to ensure the workflow operates as expected.

  2. Verify that the membership access is granted correctly and any additional actions, such as emails, are triggered.



  3. Once tested, toggle the workflow to Publish and then Save the workflow.


Frequently Asked Questions


Q: Why isn’t my Welcome Email from Membership settings being sent?

This usually happens when you've also created a Welcome Email in your Workflow. If you program a Welcome Email in a Workflow, the system automatically disables the option to send the default Welcome Email from Membership settings. As a result, no Welcome Email is sent at all, unless your Workflow explicitly includes an email step for it.


Only use one method to send your Welcome Email—either:


  1. Enable it in Membership Settings, OR

  2. Program it in a Workflow with an Email step.


Q: Can I set up multiple workflows for different membership courses?

Yes, you can create separate workflows for each course to customize triggers and actions based on specific needs.


Q: What happens if a payment fails?

You can configure workflows to handle failed payments by notifying the user and pausing their access until payment is resolved.


Q: Can I combine workflows with email campaigns for membership?

Absolutely! Use workflows to trigger personalized email campaigns, such as welcome emails or course completion reminders.


Q: How do I track users who gained access through workflows?

KenjiAI provides tracking and reporting tools to monitor user actions and workflow performance.
